title: Authority intake and prepared package-overlay gate

authority.package_tip: resolve exact origin package-branch tip at intake

objective.statement: Re-read remote main, PR #20, exact package tip, prepared two-parent merge topology, worktree cleanliness, toolchain, and Atlassian identifiers before any source mutation.
objective.observable_success: A machine intake receipt proves exact source/package/prepared identities and package availability, or stops before mutation.
non_goals: Changing scientific tolerances or expected outputs

P0_failure_modes.trigger: Remote main or PR #20 head/tree differs from the package.

required_detection.test: Preserve paths and STOP; never reset or stash without explicit ownership.

P1_failure_modes.trigger: PM-7 or Confluence page binding differs.
The implementation branch contains the source parent but not the package parent.

required_detection.test: STOP BLOCKED_BY_AUTHORITY_DRIFT; package overlay must be orchestrator-prepared before Codex starts.

forbidden_changes: Do not change reference tolerances or expected scientific outputs to make tests pass.
Do not guess across a scientific or numerical specification boundary.
Do not suppress failed stages, cells, tests, or Atlassian drift.

preconditions.command: git fetch --prune origin main research/a1-post-a2a3-kernel-rerun docs/k0-codex-execution-package-20260827 research/k0-stage-telemetry-integration-20260827

preconditions.expect: exit 0; exact ordered two-parent prepared merge

preconditions.command: git merge-base --is-ancestor e1124586a4029f86669e7489278c61ef676d61aa HEAD && git merge-base --is-ancestor "$(git rev-parse origin/docs/k0-codex-execution-package-20260827)" HEAD

invariants.statement: No source mutation occurs before exact authority and dirty-worktree inspection.
The exact package parent is present before WU-00 and contributes only control-package paths relative to the source parent.

failure_modes.trigger: Remote main or PR #20 head/tree differs from the package.

required_detection.test: Preserve paths and STOP; never reset or stash without explicit ownership.

Prepared HEAD lacks exact package ancestry or introduces source paths through the overlay.

ordered_steps.action: Record exact main, source parent, package parent, prepared-start commit/tree and parents, branch, dirty state, Rust/Cargo versions, control PR, Jira, and Confluence IDs.
Confirm the branch was prepared by the orchestrator as the exact two-parent package-overlay merge; Codex performs no branch or overlay operation.
must_preserve: no branch creation or switching inside Codex

negative: mutate one recorded SHA in a temporary receipt and verify rejection
in a temporary clone, remove package ancestry or alter one overlay source path and verify rejection
